slots.label: Player character
slots.description: The character the player controls: walks, runs and jumps in the platformer, GTA, endless runner, RPG and point-and-click starters, or a unit selected and moved in the RTS and tile starters. A rigged character with Idle, Walk, Run, Jump and Death animations.

slots.label: Enemy character
slots.description: An opponent the player fights: it chases the player and is shot in the FPS with enemies and the vampire survivor, and it is the target blown away by the tank. A rigged character with Idle, Walk or Run and Death animations, recognizable as hostile.

slots.label: NPC or ally character
slots.description: A friendly character the player walks to and talks to (RPG, point-and-click): it stands and opens a dialog. A rigged character with an Idle animation, recognizable as friendly.

slots.label: Monster or creature
slots.description: The creature hunting the player in the horror starters: it roams, chases the player and ends the game when it catches them, and is shot in the FPS horror. A rigged creature with Idle and Walk or Run animations, scarier than character.enemy.

slots.label: Drivable ground vehicle
slots.description: The vehicle the player drives on the ground (driving, racing, GTA): a car, kart, truck, tractor or sled. Not a boat or an aircraft.

slots.label: Player aircraft
slots.description: The flying vehicle the player pilots (flight simulator, shoot'em up, twin-stick shooter): a plane, spaceship or any flying vessel.

slots.label: Enemy aircraft
slots.description: The flying vehicles the player shoots down in the shoot'em up and the twin-stick shooter.

slots.label: Turret vehicle base
slots.description: The hull of the tank, which drives. Fill the three tank slots from the same model set.

slots.label: Turret vehicle turret
slots.description: The turret of the tank, which rotates on the hull. Fill the three tank slots from the same model set.

slots.label: Turret vehicle cannon
slots.description: The barrel of the tank, which aims up and down and fires. Fill the three tank slots from the same model set.

slots.label: First person weapon
slots.description: The gun held in first-person view in the FPS starters: the player aims it with the crosshair and fires it, and its bullets hit what it points at. It must shoot: a pistol, rifle, shotgun, blaster, crossbow or bow. Never a melee weapon or a tool (sword, axe, shovel, candy cane).

slots.label: Player projectile
slots.description: What the player fires: the bullets of the shoot'em up, twin-stick shooter and vampire survivor, and the tank shell, which explodes where it lands. Small and flying: a bullet, arrow, cannonball, fireball or snowball.

slots.label: Enemy projectile
slots.description: What the enemies fire at the player in the shoot'em up. Small and flying, and different from projectile.player.

slots.label: Coin or currency pickup
slots.description: A collectible the player picks up by walking into it, counted as a score (the coins of the platformer). Small and rewarding, about as tall as it is wide: a coin, gem, star or fruit.

slots.label: Hazard or trap
slots.description: A trap the player must avoid in the endless runner: touching it fails the run. Clearly dangerous: spikes, a saw, fire or a mine.

slots.label: Tree
slots.description: The trees: scattered by the thousands in the forests of the expanded starters, where the player and vehicles collide with their trunks, and placed on tiles in the tile placement starters. Something tall growing from the ground, in the style of the setting: a pine, palm, dead tree or alien plant.

slots.label: Grass or bush
slots.description: Small vegetation scattered densely on the ground of the expanded starters, which the player walks through (it has no collision), and the decorative grass of the RPG, RTS and point-and-click starters. Low and small: grass, a bush, flowers or mushrooms. Not a tree or an object.

slots.label: Large rock
slots.description: Large rocks scattered on the terrain of the expanded starters, where the player and vehicles collide with them: boulders that block the way. A rock takes the volume of the placeholder rock, whatever its shape.

slots.label: Small rock
slots.description: Small stones scattered densely on the ground of the expanded starters, walked over: pebbles and small rocks. A stone takes the volume of the placeholder stone, whatever its shape.

slots.label: Log or raw resource
slots.description: A raw material lying on the ground: the logs harvested and carried in the survival crafting starters, and the fallen logs of the horror forests. Long and lying: a log, branch, plank or bundle of material.

slots.label: First crop or food item
slots.description: The first crop of the farming starters: it grows from a seed planted in a dirt plot, and is picked up when grown. Something grown from the soil: a vegetable, fruit, pumpkin or mushroom. Not cooked food or an object. Different from crop.b.

slots.label: Second crop or food item
slots.description: The second crop of the farming starters: it grows from a seed planted in a dirt plot, and is picked up when grown. Something grown from the soil: a vegetable, fruit, pumpkin or mushroom. Not cooked food or an object. Different from crop.a.

slots.label: Bag, crate or chest
slots.description: A container about as tall as it is wide: the seed bags the player clicks to get seeds in the farming starters, and the crates used as cover in the FPS with enemies. A bag, crate, barrel or chest.

slots.label: Tall building or tower
slots.description: A tall building, at least twice as tall as it is wide: the skyscrapers of the GTA starter and the tower placed on a tile in the tile placement starters. A skyscraper, tower, silo, lighthouse or obelisk. Not a house (building.house).

slots.label: House or low building
slots.description: A house or a low building standing on its own, about as tall as it is wide or lower: the houses of the GTA, driving and RPG starters, the buildings of the RTS, the barns of the farming starters, the crypts and cabins of the horror starters. A house, shop, barn, cabin, hut, tent, crypt or base module. Not a tower (building.tower).

slots.label: Small obstacle
slots.description: A small obstacle on a road or track, about as tall as it is wide: the traffic cones the car knocks away in the driving and racing starters. Something a vehicle hits and pushes: a cone, bollard, barrel, crate or fire hydrant. Not a long barrier (prop.barrier).

slots.label: Barrier or low wall
slots.description: A long, low obstacle lining a road or giving cover, about three times as long as it is tall: the barriers along the racing and driving tracks, the sandbags and containers the player hides behind in the FPS with enemies and the tank. A road barrier, sandbags, fence, low wall, hedge or log. Not a cone (prop.obstacle).

slots.label: Ground
slots.description: The texture of flat ground boxes: the ground of the starters without a terrain.

slots.label: Ground with a tile grid
slots.description: The texture of floors and grounds with a visible tile grid: the floor of the camera monitoring building, and the grounds of the RTS, flight simulator, shoot'em up and point-and-click starters.

slots.label: Wall and building faces
slots.description: The texture of walls, platforms and building faces made of boxes.

slots.label: Road or track surface
slots.description: The texture of roads and tracks made of boxes (driving, racing, tank).

slots.label: Water or lava
slots.description: The texture of water areas made of boxes (or lava, in a fiery setting).

slots.label: Placement grid overlay
slots.description: The texture of the placement grid of the tile placement starters.

slots.label: Pushable box faces
slots.description: The texture of pushable boxes and furniture: a crate, wooden or metal box.

slots.label: Finish line
slots.description: The texture of the finish line of the racing starters: a checkered or striped band.

slots.label: Farm plot or diggable ground
slots.description: The texture of the farm plots where seeds are planted: tilled soil.

slots.label: Main ground of a terrain (grass, sand, snow...)
slots.description: The main ground of a 3D terrain, covering most of it: grass, sand, snow, dirt.

slots.label: Paths, trails and fields of a terrain
slots.description: The paths, trails and fields painted on a 3D terrain.

slots.label: Paved roads of a terrain
slots.description: The paved roads painted on a 3D terrain.

slots.label: Cliffs and steep slopes of a terrain
slots.description: The cliffs and steep slopes of a 3D terrain.

slots.label: Shores and beaches of a terrain
slots.description: The shores and beaches of a 3D terrain.

slots.label: Sidewalks and squares of a terrain
slots.description: The sidewalks and squares of a 3D terrain.

slots.label: Color of the grass blades at their base
slots.description: The color of the grass blades at their base, close to the color of terrain.ground.

slots.label: Color of the grass blades at their tip
slots.description: The color of the grass blades at their tip, lighter than terrain.grass.base.

slots.label: Daytime sky
slots.description: The sky of most starters, around the whole scene.

slots.label: Night or gloomy sky
slots.description: The night or gloomy sky of the horror starters.

slots.label: Side view player character
slots.description: The character the player controls in the 2D platformer, platformer shooter and endless runner starters, seen from the side and facing right. It stands on platforms about as tall as itself: a character close to a square, with idle, walk and jump animations when the pack has them.

slots.label: Side view platform
slots.description: The image repeated along the platforms of the side view starters, which are one tile (64 pixels) tall: a ground tile that repeats seamlessly from left to right, with its surface at the top.

slots.label: Side view background
slots.description: The image repeated behind the whole scene of the side view starters: a plain or evenly patterned sky or wall that repeats seamlessly in both directions.

slots.label: Side view collectible
slots.description: What the player collects in the 2D platformer: a coin, gem or star, half the size of the player.

slots.label: Side view hazard
slots.description: What the player must jump over in the endless runner: spikes, a saw or a hostile creature, about as large as the player.

slots.label: Side view target
slots.description: What the player shoots in the platformer shooter: a target or an enemy, floating in the air, about as large as the player.

slots.label: Side view projectile
slots.description: What the player fires in the platformer shooter: a bullet, fireball or arrow flying to the right.

slots.label: Flappy flyer
slots.description: What the player keeps in the air in the flappy bird starter, seen from the side and facing right: a bird, plane or any flying thing.

slots.label: Flappy obstacle
slots.description: The tall obstacles the flyer passes between in the flappy bird starter, rising from the ground: a rock, pillar, pipe or tree, much taller than wide.

slots.label: Flappy ground and ceiling
slots.description: The image repeated along the floor and the ceiling of the flappy bird starter, two tiles (128 pixels) tall.

slots.label: Flappy background
slots.description: The image repeated behind the whole scene of the flappy bird starter: a plain or evenly patterned sky.

slots.label: Top view player
slots.description: The character or vehicle the player moves in the top-down, twin-stick shooter and vampire survivor starters, seen from straight above and facing right. It turns to face where it goes or aims.

slots.label: Top view enemy
slots.description: What chases the player in the twin-stick shooter and the vampire survivor, seen from straight above and facing right.

slots.label: Top view projectile
slots.description: What the player fires in the twin-stick shooter and the vampire survivor, seen from above and flying to the right.

slots.label: Top view obstacle
slots.description: The round obstacles scattered in the top-down starter, one tile wide: a bush, rock or barrel seen from above.

slots.label: Top view large obstacle
slots.description: The large blocks the player walks around in the top-down starter, two tiles wide: a tree, building or crate stack seen from above.

slots.label: Top view ground
slots.description: The image repeated under the whole scene of the twin-stick shooter and the vampire survivor: a ground seen from above that repeats seamlessly.

slots.label: Top view ground tiles
slots.description: The 64 pixels tiles painting the ground of the top-down starter. Its tiles play these roles: `ground`, `ground.detail1` and `ground.detail2` (the main ground and two variations of it), and `area` (the fill of a path or zone drawn on the ground).

slots.label: Shoot'em up player
slots.description: The ship or plane the player flies in the side-scrolling shoot'em up, seen from above and facing right.

slots.label: Shoot'em up enemy
slots.description: The ships or planes flying at the player in the shoot'em up, seen from above. They are drawn facing right and the starter turns them around.

slots.label: Shoot'em up player projectile
slots.description: What the player fires in the shoot'em up, flying to the right.

slots.label: Shoot'em up enemy projectile
slots.description: What the enemies fire in the shoot'em up. Drawn flying to the right, and different from the player's.

slots.label: Shoot'em up background
slots.description: The image scrolling under the shoot'em up: a ground, sea or space seen from above that repeats seamlessly.

slots.label: Top view car
slots.description: The car the player drives in the 2D driving and racing starters, seen from above and facing right, about twice as long as wide.

slots.label: Top view track obstacle
slots.description: The round obstacles the car bumps into and pushes: a tire stack, bush, cone or barrel seen from above.

slots.label: Driving ground tiles
slots.description: The 64 pixels tiles painting the ground of the 2D driving and racing starters. Its tiles play these roles: `ground`, `ground.detail1` and `ground.detail2` (what is beside the road, and two variations of it), and `area` (the surface of the road).

slots.label: Board piece
slots.description: The main piece moved on the board of the draggable tiles starter, fitting in one tile: a unit, pawn or character.

slots.label: Second board piece
slots.description: Another kind of piece on the board, fitting in one tile: a tower, building or vehicle.

slots.label: Board scenery piece
slots.description: A piece of scenery on the board, fitting in one tile: a tree, bush or rock.

slots.label: Board tiles
slots.description: The 64 pixels tiles painting the board of the draggable tiles starter. Its tiles play these roles: `ground` (what surrounds the board), `cell.a` and `cell.b` (the two alternating cells of the board).

slots.label: Top view water
slots.description: A 192 pixels image of water (3 by 3 tiles) repeated over the ponds of the point and click and unit selection starters.

slots.label: Top-down RPG player
slots.description: The character the player walks in the top-down RPG, farming and survival starters, seen from the front like in a classic RPG. It needs an animation for each direction: walking right, down, left and up.

slots.label: Top-down RPG character
slots.description: A character standing in the top-down RPG starter, who the player talks to, seen from the front.

slots.label: Top-down RPG building
slots.description: The buildings and large obstacles the player walks around in the top-down RPG, farming and survival starters: a house, hut, statue or large tree seen from the front.

slots.label: Top-down RPG ground tiles
slots.description: The 64 pixels tiles painting the ground of the top-down RPG, farming and survival starters. Its tiles play these roles: `ground`, `ground.detail1` and `ground.detail2` (the main ground and two variations of it), and `area` (the fill of a path, a field or a zone drawn on the ground).

slots.label: First crop
slots.description: The first thing grown in the farming starter, once harvested: a vegetable, fruit or nut, one tile large.

slots.label: Seed of the first crop
slots.description: The seed of the first crop, one tile large.

slots.label: First crop, planted
slots.description: The first crop growing in the ground, one tile large: a sprout or small plant.

slots.label: Wild plant of the first crop
slots.description: The wild plant the player harvests to get seeds of the first crop.

slots.label: Second crop
slots.description: The second thing grown in the farming starter, once harvested.

slots.label: Seed of the second crop
slots.description: The seed of the second crop.

slots.label: Second crop, planted
slots.description: The second crop growing in the ground.

slots.label: Wild plant of the second crop
slots.description: The wild plant the player harvests to get seeds of the second crop.

slots.label: Rock resource
slots.description: The rock the player collects and carries in the survival starter, one tile large.

slots.label: Wood resource
slots.description: The wood the player collects and carries in the survival starter, one tile large.

slots.label: Boulder to mine
slots.description: The boulder the player mines for rocks in the survival starter, two tiles large.

slots.label: Tree to cut
slots.description: The tree the player cuts for wood in the survival starter, two tiles large.

slots.label: Strategy unit
slots.description: The units the player selects and moves in the unit selection starter, smaller than a tile: a soldier, worker or vehicle.

slots.label: Strategy building
slots.description: The buildings the units walk around in the unit selection starter: a house, tower or base.

slots.label: Impassable ground
slots.description: The image repeated over the ground units cannot cross in the unit selection starter: rocks, a forest or a wall seen from above, one tile large.

slots.label: Beat'em up player
slots.description: The fighter the player controls in the beat'em up, seen from the side and facing right, with a pose to stand, to prepare a hit, to hit, and to be hurt.

slots.label: Beat'em up enemy
slots.description: The fighter the player fights in the beat'em up, with the same poses as the player, drawn facing right.

slots.label: Beat'em up wall
slots.description: The image repeated over the walls closing the street of the beat'em up.

slots.label: Physics playground background
slots.description: The image repeated behind the physics starter: a sky or landscape that repeats seamlessly from left to right.

slots.label: Physics playground ground
slots.description: The image repeated over the ground and walls of the physics starter.

slots.label: Physics ball
slots.description: The round thing thrown or rolling in the physics starter.

slots.label: Light block
slots.description: The light blocks stacked in the physics starter, three times taller than wide: a wooden plank.

slots.label: Heavy block
slots.description: The heavy square blocks of the physics starter: a stone or metal block.

slots.label: Top-down RPG small obstacle
slots.description: The small obstacles scattered in the pixel art top-down starter, one tile large: a bush, rock or stump.

slots.label: Top-down RPG wall
slots.description: The image repeated over the walls of the pixel art top-down starter: a hedge, wall or rocks, one tile large.

slots.label: Top-down RPG pond
slots.description: An image of a pond, 3 by 3 tiles, with its shore on the outer tiles: the pixel art point and click starter stretches its middle to draw ponds of any size.

slots.label: Strategy ground tiles
slots.description: The 64 pixels tiles painting the ground of the unit selection and tile placement starters. Its tiles play these roles: `ground`, `ground.detail1` and `ground.detail2` (the main ground and two variations of it), and `area` (the fill of a path or zone drawn on the ground).

slots.label: Strategy pond
slots.description: A 192 pixels image of water (3 by 3 tiles) repeated over the pond of the unit selection starter.
